text:
maya_sales: Heads-up — FinLedger procurement emailed asking for a "quick" compliance bundle for the POC. They listed: SOC 2 summary, ISO scope confirmation, and a pen-test attestation or third-party letter. They want it before their vendor review on Tue. Can we pull together something that meets procurement?

devon_se: We need to confirm whether the POC uses Hosted API or Redwood Dedicated. That determines screenshots and network diagrams. Which environment did sales promise?

maya_sales: POC is Dedicated dev pool per the SOW. We told them isolated tenant.

olivia_grc: I have a redact-ready SOC2 one-pager and an ISO scope statement. I can generate a redacted Type II cover note. Will upload to Sales/FinLedger by EOD.

andre_security: For the pen-test they requested "third-party letter or equivalent". If we do vendor attestation, we should be explicit about scope and exclusions. Draft attestation I can produce includes test window and statement of no critical/high findings.

kevin_support: I can capture the infra artifacts: network topology svg, firewall rules snippet, KMS usage screenshot, and SIEM retention sample. Will sanitize tenant IDs before upload.

maya_sales: Procurement said legal might accept vendor-signed attestation for the POC but want to see wording. Please add the suggested clause about relying on vendor attestation only for the POC period.

devon_se: Note: for Dedicated POC we should include kube RBAC snapshot and pod-level networkPolicy example. Ill export those now.

olivia_grc: Uploaded SOC2_onepager_redacted.pdf and ISO_scope_finledger.md to https://redwood.app/drive/sales/finledger. Andre: can you draft the attestation by 10:30am tomorrow?

andre_security: Yes — will draft. Draft will state: scope (dedicated dev pool), test window, statement of findings (no critical/high outstanding), and signed by Head of Security. Will also include a paragraph on exclusions (customer-provided code, external integrations).

kevin_support: Assembling evidence checklist now. Plan: SOC2 one-pager, ISO scope, pen-test attestation, infra diagrams, RBAC/networkpolicy snippets, KMS policy extract, SIEM retention screenshot. Ill zip and upload to Sales/FinLedger/compliance_bundle_v1.zip. ETA 3pm local.

maya_sales: Great. If procurement insists on a third-party report, what's the fastest path?

andre_security: Third-party report is possible but not within the POC window unless we have an existing recent engagement we can share a letter for. Otherwise it becomes a procurement item with lead time and cost.

olivia_grc: Tagging legal: @legal_team  please advise if vendor attestation language needs specific wording for FinLedger procurement.

filebot: file-bot: uploaded Sales/FinLedger/compliance_bundle_v1.zip (1.8MB) to internal drive.

kevin_support: Reminder: scrub screenshots for tenant IDs and redact any customer data before packaging. Ill include a manifest of files in the zip.

maya_sales: Thanks everyone. Ill coordinate with FinLedger and update here once they confirm whether vendor attestation is acceptable.
